actual_session_failures.failure: The wrapper crossed its projection boundary and lost attributable terminal output.
The first sparse set exposed inherited paths as apparent deletions because the new index was empty.
Removing args from every candidate produced semantic collisions.
A path regex misclassified public URI scheme fragments as confirmed Windows paths.
The first enumeration wrapper finished without a retained terminal projection.
A retained diagnostic sentence itself matched the corrected path scanner.
The new branch tracking ref existed, but the repository fetch refspec did not map it for symbolic upstream inference.
A native Git command and exit-code expression were combined inside one object expression and failed to parse before any Git query.
The combined version wrapper ended without an attributable terminal projection after its processes exited.
A constant used a colon instead of an equals sign for the unsupported-operation request initializer.
The catalogue hash step joined an owner-relative source path to the promotion root twice after the sixteen owner source files had been created.

The owner promotion source and installed files matched across all sixteen bindings, but the shared core contained the JSON serialization of a Buffer rather than the raw combined runtime bytes. Every runner refused with LIBRARY_BINDING.

The one-line wrapper missed a closing parenthesis in the external runner parity expression and failed before any validation check ran; Node also emitted a Windows handle assertion during the failed exit.
The validator treated its own private-route and private-content pattern literals as two unresolved scanner candidates, with five lexical occurrences total and zero confirmed payload hits.
The complete cumulative ledger contained 100336 words, exceeding the current 100000-word per-document ceiling by 336 words.

The wrapper staged the intended files and proved allowlist parity, but a malformed x1 revision token made the x1 immutability field non-attributable and omitted a trustworthy x2 and diff-hygiene summary.
